title: Binch Akara
description: Binch Akara is a Sierra Leone classic prepared with black-eyed peas, yellow onion, scotch bonnet pepper. A measured home-style version, with ingredients assigned to the cooking steps where they are used.

steps.instruction: Soak the dried beans or peas in plentiful cold water for 480 minutes, then drain and discard the soaking liquid; keep refrigerated in hot conditions.
Combine the listed ingredients in a bowl until evenly mixed; avoid overworking delicate components.
Whisk or whip the listed ingredients to a smooth, light consistency, then keep cool until needed.
Fry shaped portions in small batches in oil heated to about 170–175°C for about 18 minutes, until golden; drain on a rack.
